owner_direction: #167 comment 5574408755 item 2 (completion ceiling from actual L5 behaviour)
scope: WHAT L5 DID only. Pair costs are pre-rebate, pre-fee acquisition costs of a $1.00-paying pair, > 1.00 mass intact. What PMUS economics can support is a separate study; see economic_overlay_attachment_points.

labels.relation: polymarket_l5.action_model._relation on the canonical residual BEFORE the fill: flat < 1 share -> open; surplus side -> extend; deficit side -> complete
labels.state: polymarket_l5.action_model.state_key: band(LAST OBSERVED fill price) | tte bucket at the complete | |residual shares| bucket -- identical to live keys
labels.own_band: band of the COMPLETE fill's own price (not part of the live key)
labels.engine_avg: complete price + average cost (cum spend/cum qty) of the surplus side before the fill
labels.marginal_lifo: complete price + qty-weighted price of the most recent surplus lot(s) consumed, LIFO, matched part only
labels.window_realized: window's matched-pair unit cost at settlement (wavg_up + wavg_down, final canonical row), per complete
labels.completed_usd: complete price x matched qty (the part of the fill that formed pairs); dollar shares use this
labels.pairs_pct: share of completed CONTRACTS (pairs) above the threshold; dollars scale with price, contracts do not
labels.usd: full fill dollars, including any overshoot beyond the surplus
labels.inv_usd_before: |residual shares| x average cost of the surplus side = unmatched dollars before the complete
labels.preceding: relation of the previous BUY in the window; extend streak length counted in fills
labels.pct_above: share strictly above the threshold after rounding the pair cost to 6 dp (0.41+0.59 is 1.00, not above)
labels.percentiles: p-values are fill-count percentiles; usd_p50/usd_p90 are completed-dollar-weighted

limits: derived from EXECUTED TRADES on the public activity feed: a fill is not a quote
concurrency here is FILL concurrency, a lower bound on quoting concurrency
'unknown' maker_taker is outside takerOnly coverage and is never treated as maker

economic_overlay_attachment_points.note: NAMED ONLY, not computed here. The overlay converts an observed pair cost into supported/unsupported at PMUS.
inputs: maker rebate per filled dollar on PMUS, per leg (complete leg and the surplus leg it matches), from the venue schedule in force at the fill time
taker fee / maker fee per filled dollar (if any) per leg
tick rounding of the complement price (floor to tick, as complement_target does) and the resulting fixed-point pair cost
settlement payout per pair (1.00) and any settlement/redemption cost
minimum-edge parameter currently in hard_pair_bound (1.00 - MIN_EDGE) and PAIR_OBSERVATION_CAP
capital lock time (complete timestamp to settlement) if a carry cost is to be charged
economic_overlay_attachment_points.attach_to: each COMPLETE record's engine_avg (the basis the engine prices through); the comparison is supported_ceiling = 1.00 + rebates - fees - min_edge (per pair dollar) against this study's observed distribution by state

limitations: fills only: a COMPLETE here is a filled deficit-side buy, not the quote L5 posted; the ceiling is the distribution of filled completes, resting completes that never filled are invisible
state price band is the previous fill's price (the live model's market-price proxy), not the book at the fill; it can be the opposite side's price
engine_avg uses the canonical average-cost basis (cum spend / cum qty), which includes every earlier lot on the surplus side, matched or not; marginal_lifo is the alternative reading
window_realized is an average-cost allocation at settlement, not a per-fill fact; it is the number the ledger locks
maker/taker is known only inside takerOnly coverage (Aug 28-31); pair costs are not conditioned on it
3431 completes exceed the surplus (overshoot); pair costs there cover the matched part and dollar shares use completed_usd
two lifetime SELL rows are applied to the lot ledger LIFO and otherwise ignored
pair costs exclude rebates and fees by construction (owner: separate the two questions)
the canonical file has no fills between 2026-04 and 2026-08 (Mar 1931 / Apr 3338 / Aug 66715 rows); 'by month' is three eras and the August cohort dominates every pooled number
